title: New Digs
summary: Ground has been freshly disturbed for new accommodations in Toronto's King West area. The Manga-managed twin hotels will run through the block from Richmond Street West to Camden Street, with a tower facing each street and a low podium between them. Seen at the back of the photo, a heritage wall is held aloft by an unseen scaffold, its back protected from the elements while it waits for new concrete structure to hold it up.
